## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Python formatting, linting, typing, and tests pass.
- [ ] JavaScript tests pass.
- [ ] The package and Docker image build.
- [ ] UI changes were checked with keyboard navigation and responsive widths.
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` reflect changed behavior.

## Privacy and safety

- [ ] Camera frames and session data remain local and ephemeral, or the change
      clearly documents and justifies a new boundary.
- [ ] User-facing text makes no diagnostic or medical claim.
- [ ] The change contains no recordings, personal data, credentials, or generated
      runtime artifacts.

## Screenshots

Include before/after images for visual changes, with personal imagery removed.
